commands.command: 'Get-Content inputs/TASK.md; Get-ChildItem -Force; if (Test-Path .agents/skills) { Get-ChildItem .agents/skills -Recurse -Filter SKILL.md | Select-Object -ExpandProperty FullName }'

'Get-Content .agents/skills/bio-thesis-formatter/SKILL.md; Get-Content inputs/intake.json; Get-ChildItem inputs -Recurse | Select-Object FullName,Length; Get-ChildItem .agents/skills/bio-thesis-formatter -Recurse | Select-Object FullName'

"@'
import json,re
from pathlib import Path
from zipfile import ZipFile
from xml.etree import ElementTree as E
W='{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main}'
rows=json.loads(Path('inputs/intake.json').read_text())
secrets=[r[k] for r in rows for k in ('author','student_id')]
def tree(el):
 return (el.tag,dict(el.attrib),el.text or '',tuple(tree(c) for c in el))
for row in rows:
 with ZipFile(Path('inputs')/row['template']) as a, ZipFile(Path('output')/row['output']) as b:
  assert b.testzip() is None
  assert a.namelist()==b.namelist()
  changed=[]
  for name in a.namelist():
   original,result=a.read(name),b.read(name)
   assert all(s.encode() not in result for s in secrets),name
   if name.endswith(('.xml','.rels')):
    root=E.fromstring(result)
    text=''.join(root.itertext())
    assert all(s not in text for s in secrets)
    assert '{{' not in text,name
   if original==result: continue
   changed.append(name)
   if name=='[Content_Types].xml':
    assert row['template'].endswith('.dotx')
    original=original.replace(b'wordprocessingml.template.main+xml',b'wordprocessingml.document.main+xml')
    assert tree(E.fromstring(original))==tree(E.fromstring(result))
   else:
    assert name in ('word/document.xml','word/header1.xml')
    orig,final=E.fromstring(original),E.fromstring(result)
    # Collapse only text runs in each paragraph for comparison, preserving all other nodes/attributes.
    values={k:row[k] for k in ('title_en','major')}
    values.update(author='【匿名评审隐去】',student_id='【匿名评审隐去】')
    for p,q in zip(orig.iter(W+'p'),final.iter(W+'p')):
     ot=list(p.iter(W+'t')); ft=list(q.iter(W+'t'))
     assert len(ot)==len(ft)
     expected=''.join(t.text or '' for t in ot)
     for k,v in values.items(): expected=expected.replace('{{'+k+'}}',v)
     assert expected==''.join(t.text or '' for t in ft)
     for t in ot+ft:t.text=''
    assert tree(orig)==tree(final),name
  doc=E.fromstring(b.read('word/document.xml'))
  paragraphs=[''.join(p.itertext()) for p in doc.iter(W+'p')]
  assert 'Candidate: 【匿名评审隐去】' in paragraphs
  assert 'Registration: 【匿名评审隐去】' in paragraphs
  assert 'Programme: '+row['major'] in paragraphs
  assert 'Working title: '+row['title_en'] in paragraphs
  print(row['output']+': PASS; title/programme complete; identities absent; labels and anonymous slots retained; all other XML structure and package assets preserved. Changed parts: '+', '.join(changed))
'@ | python -B -"
